CustomObject.label: Integration Log
CustomObject.description: Audit + dead-letter record for every external integration call (ERP, logistics, payments). Captures direction, system, status, request/response, error, related record, and retry count. Backbone of Phase 4 resilience (retry + dead-letter) and the Trusted WAF pillar. OWD Private. See Phase 4 discovery (ADR candidate P4-3/P4-6).
